subject: dsmextra issues with older versions of R

messages.author: e5f075b1f22f149c
messages.subject: dsmextra issues with older versions of R
parts:
Hi listfolk,

Some users have recently reported issues when trying to install / run dsmextra in older versions of R (thank you to Deepti Gupta). We recommend R is updated to version 4.0 or higher for the package to run as expected.

Cheers, Phil
